Second independent check — is this M13 finding a REAL, actionable issue to fix before merge? Read the code; be skeptical; confirm only with a concrete pointer.
File:components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx (components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx:50-51, 69, 74, 79)
Activity-table status badges expose raw enum tokens with no icon (machine text, color-only reinforcement)
The Sessions/Payments/Payouts tables render status via <Badge tone={...} label={r.status} /> where r.status is the raw database enum string — so screen-reader and sighted users see unlabeled machine tokens like "in_progress", "captured", "authorized", "scheduled" instead of human copy. This also violates CLAUDE.md rule 7 (all user-facing copy through messages/en.json) — note the table headers ARE translated (t("admin.colStatus")) but the cell values are not. Additionally, the local Badge wrapper (line 50-51) calls <StatusBadge tone> WITHOUT an icon, unlike every other status pill in the app (provider/PayoutsTable, IncomingRequests, customer/UpcomingBookings, and even the sibling UsersTable all pass an `icon`). StatusBadge's own contract says meaning should be carried by icon + text together, with tone as reinforcement; here a colored pill plus a raw token is the only signal, weakening the no-color-alone guarantee for distinguishing e.g. failed vs captured payments.

input.reason:
CONFIRMED — real and actionable. Verified against the source:

1. Raw enum tokens shown to users: In components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx the status cells render `<Badge ... label={r.status} />` (lines 69, 74, 79) where `r.status` is the unmodified DB enum. app/(admin)/admin/activity/page.tsx (lines 41, 48, 55) maps `status: s.status` / `p.status` directly from the query rows with no formatting. So sighted and screen-reader users literally see machine tokens like "in_progress", "captured", "authorized", "scheduled", "refunded".

2. i18n violation (CLAUDE.md rule 7) is concrete: table headers go through t() but cell values do not. Message keys for these already exist in messages/en.json — "statusCompleted" (Completed), "statusCancelled" (Cancelled), "statusInProgress" (In progress) at lines 433-435, and provider.payoutPaid/payoutScheduled — so the human copy exists and just isn't used here (payment statuses authorized/captured/refunded/failed would need new keys).

3. Missing icon / no-color-alone weakening is real: the local Badge wrapper (AdminActivityTables.tsx:50-51) calls `<StatusBadge tone={tone}>{label}</StatusBadge>` with no `icon`. StatusBadge's own doc comment (components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx:14-17) states meaning must be carried by icon + text together, tone is reinforcement only. Every sibling status pill passes an icon: UsersTable (Ban/CircleCheck), provider/PayoutsTable (CalendarCheck/Clock), customer/UpcomingBookings (CalendarClock), provider/IncomingRequests. The admin tables are the lone exception, so a colored pill + raw token is the only differentiator (e.g. failed vs captured payments rely on tone color plus an untranslated token).

Concrete fix: add status->label maps backed by messages/en.json keys (reuse existing statusCompleted/InProgress/Cancelled, add keys for authorized/captured/refunded/failed and payout paid/scheduled) and pass per-status icons into the Badge wrapper, matching the sibling tables. Pointers: components/admin/AdminActivityTables.tsx:50-51,69,74,79; tones map lines 34-48; messages/en.json:433-435.
